ticketTitle: Add server-side search support for Users list (confirm UI first, then implement)
ticketDescription:
## Source

Discovery `search-across-features`, file: `.caf/discovery/search-across-features/prd.md` + `flow.md`

## Problem

`apps/api/src/users/users.service.ts findAll` uses the generic `PaginationDto`, which has no `search` field — the users list backend cannot support search at all today. Discovery did not confirm whether the users list frontend currently has a search UI component.

## Target User

Internal merchant staff managing user accounts via the web dashboard.

## Scope of This Ticket

* First: confirm whether `apps/web/src/modules/users/...` (or equivalent module) has a search UI (`UiSearch`) already wired to the list. If it does not, adding search UI there is Out-of-Scope for this ticket (that would be new UI/UX, not a consistency fix) — flag it separately instead.
* If UI already exists: add a dedicated query DTO for the users list endpoint (follow `ProductsQueryDto` / `CategoriesQueryDto` pattern) with an optional `search` field; confirm covered fields (`name`, `email`, possibly `phone` — open question from discovery) with product owner.
* Wire `search` into the Prisma `where` clause in `users.service.ts findAll`, scoped by `merchant_id`.

## Out-of-Scope

* Adding new search UI to the users list if it doesn't currently exist (separate UX decision).
* Full-text/fuzzy search, cross-module search.
* Adding automated test coverage.
* Changing the base `PaginationDto` globally.

## Flow

If search UI exists: same pattern as merchant/outlet/role — user types in `UiSearch`, debounce, request hits `GET /users?search=...`, backend filters and returns matching users.

## Success Metric

If UI exists: typing in the search box returns only matching users. If UI does not exist: ticket is resolved as "confirmed no UI, backend work deferred" with a note for a future UX-scoped ticket.

## Dependency

* Open question (from discovery): confirm whether users module has search UI at all, and if so, which fields `search` should cover (name/email/phone).
